    Terms

    By using YourTerm, you accept these terms.

    YourTerm records how the app is used (visits, saves, searches, and taps), with a random ID kept on your device. If you sign in, it also holds your name, email, what you follow, and your college. What you send through a form is kept so we can reply. This is used to run and improve the service.
